description: Detaches a PaymentMethod object from a Customer account. Use when you need to remove a payment method from a customer without deleting it entirely.

inputSchema.description: Request model for detaching a payment method from a customer.

payment_method_id.description: The unique identifier of the payment method to detach from the customer. Must start with 'pm_' followed by alphanumeric characters.
payment_method_id.title: Payment Method Id
